Definition: Achimelek, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite
BiblicalUsage: Ahimelech = "my brother is king" or "brother of Melek"; 1) a priest murdered by Doeg at Saul's command, for supposedly assisting David; 2) a Hittite warrior under David
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
